name: lw_45468
statement: (n : ℕ) (a b : ℕ → ℕ) (hab : a ≤ b) : (∑ i ∈ Finset.range n, (a i + ∑ i ∈ Finset.range n, (b i))) ^ 2 ≥ 4 * n * ∑ i ∈ Finset.range n, (a i * b i)
closed: ∀ (n : ℕ) (a b : ℕ → ℕ) (hab : a ≤ b), (∑ i ∈ Finset.range n, (a i + ∑ i ∈ Finset.range n, (b i))) ^ 2 ≥ 4 * n * ∑ i ∈ Finset.range n, (a i * b i)
type: ∀ (n : ℕ) (a b : ℕ → ℕ), a ≤ b → (∑ i ∈ Finset.range n, (a i + ∑ i ∈ Finset.range n, b i)) ^ 2 ≥ 4 * n * ∑ i ∈ Finset.range n, a i * b i
